documents.notes: KFUPM's international admissions page (SAT Track: graduate of an international high school, natural-sciences track, SAT 1350+). After SAT verification the applicant is invited to a KFUPM math assessment (a test taken, not a document). The ISEF Winners Track is a separate route. The 'Personal Guide to Joining KFUPM 2027' PDF lists documents for Saudi students and resident non-Saudis (with an Iqama), not for applicants from abroad, so it was not used.
